notes.subject: מנלם
notes.rationale: Tok Hibru מנלם i stap long Tanakh long dispela ples tasol; ol tanim tok i wokim ol kainkain mining ('perfeksen', 'kontiniuans', 'olgeta samting')

notes.subject: יטה לארץ מנלם
notes.rationale: OL tanim tok i no gat wanpela pasin: KJV 'prolong the perfection', JPS 'produce bend to the earth', YLT 'stretch out their continuance'

translation: Em i no inap kamap man i gat planti olgeta samting, na ol samting bilong en i no inap sanap wantaim; na ol i no inap brukim narapela hap long graun.

tokens.gloss: kamap man i gat planti olgeta samting
